newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's PRI to lose Congress majority - exit polls.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's PRI to lose Congress majority - exit polls.

text.p: Mexico's long-ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) is set to lose its 68-year-old majority in the lower house of Congress, two television exit polls said after elections on Sunday.
An exit poll conducted by Multivision TV gave the ruling PRI 35.82 percent of the national vote, well below the 42.2 percent it needs for an overall majority under Mexico's electoral law.
That poll gave the conservative PAN 34.49 percent and the left-wing PRD 20.80 percent.
An independent polling firm working for the PAN also showed the PRI losing its lower house majority. It gave the PRI 37.9 percent, the PAN 32.2 percent and the PRD 22.7 percent.
Preliminary official results were due from the Federal Electoral Institute (IFE) later on Sunday night.
